issues.explanation: In 转头空, 转头 is a temporal expression meaning “in the blink of an eye”; the gloss and dictionary-reference pinyin do not explain this use.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 转头 together as zhuǎn tóu, “in the blink of an eye; turning one’s head.”

issues.explanation: In 江渚上, 上 is a locative particle meaning “on/at,” not a reference to the pronunciation of 上声.
issues.suggested_fix: Use pinyin shàng and meaning “on; at.”

issues.explanation: In 喜相逢, 喜 means “happily; be glad to,” not “to be fond of.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “happily; be glad to”.

issues.explanation: In 桓、灵帝, 桓 refers to Emperor Huan, not the surname Huan.
issues.suggested_fix: Use type name and meaning “Emperor Huan.”

issues.explanation: With 宦官 as subject, 专权 means “to monopolize power” or “to wield power autocratically,” not simply the noun “autocracy.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “to monopolize power; to wield power autocratically.”

issues.explanation: In 鸡化雄, 化 is the verb “to turn into,” not a variant of 花.
issues.suggested_fix: Use pinyin huà and meaning “to turn into; become.”

issues.explanation: 南华老仙 is an appellation/name for the immortal figure and should be kept together rather than splitting 南华 from 老仙.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 南华老仙 together as a name, with meaning “Nanhua Old Immortal.”

issues.explanation: In 大贤良师, 师 is not the surname Shi. The whole phrase is Zhang Jiao’s title, “Great Teacher of Virtue.”
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 大贤良师 together as a title/word, pinyin dà xián liáng shī, meaning “Great Teacher of Virtue.”

issues.explanation: In 广收门徒, 广 is an adverb meaning “widely; extensively,” not the character radical definition.
issues.suggested_fix: Use pinyin guǎng and meaning “widely; extensively.”

issues.explanation: In 立三十六方, 立 is the verb “to establish/set up,” not the surname Li.
issues.suggested_fix: Use type word, pinyin lì, meaning “to establish; set up.”

issues.explanation: Here 方 refers to the organized divisions/units established by Zhang Jiao, not the surname Fang.
issues.suggested_fix: Use type word and a contextual meaning such as “division; district.”

issues.explanation: In 被斩, 被 is the passive marker “be; get,” not “quilt.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use type particle or word with meaning “passive marker; be subjected to.”

issues.explanation: The subject is being put into prison, so the phrase is passive in context; “to imprison” can mislead the learner into making the prisoners the agents.
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “to be imprisoned; be put in jail.”

issues.explanation: In 天公将军, 天公 is part of a formal title, not “Heavenly General” by itself; 将军 supplies “general.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “Heavenly Lord” for 天公, or annotate 天公将军 together as “Heavenly General.”

issues.explanation: In 地公将军, 地公 is part of the formal title “Earth General”; the current gloss makes the title structure unclear.
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “Earth Lord” for 地公, or annotate 地公将军 together as “Earth General.”

issues.explanation: In 人公将军, 人公 is part of the formal title “Human General”; the current gloss makes the title structure unclear.
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “Human Lord” for 人公, or annotate 人公将军 together as “Human General.”

issues.explanation: After 五十 and before 良马, 匹 is the measure word for horses, not “matching.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “measure word for horses.”

issues.explanation: In 三人打造兵器, 三 means “three”; the surname reading and meaning are incorrect.
issues.suggested_fix: Use pinyin sān and meaning “three.”

issues.explanation: In 投在刘焉麾下, 投 means “to join/submit oneself to” Liu Yan’s command, not “to throw.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “to join; submit oneself to.”

issues.explanation: In 投在刘焉麾下, 麾下 means “under someone’s command,” not simply “troops.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning “under someone’s command; under one’s banner.”
